newsitem.title: USA: U.S. stocks slip lower, NYSE sets trading curbs.
newsitem.headline: U.S. stocks slip lower, NYSE sets trading curbs.

text.p: Wall Street stocks moved lower in late-morning trade Wednesday, with the Dow industrials down about 55 points to 7706.
The New York Stock Exchange set a second round of index-arbitrage trading curbs at 1104 EDT/1504 GMT.
The Nasdaq composite was off 13 points to 1430.
The market was under pressure from several weak technology stocks as well as profit-taking after a strong rally last week, analysts said.
The 30-year bond was unchanged with a 6.72 percent yield. The S&P index futures were off 5.75 at 897.00.
